title: cyperus laevigatus subsp. albidus
intro: Cyperus laevigatus subsp. albidus, commonly known as Swamp Sedge or White-flower Sedge, is a type of aquatic grass-like plant belonging to the sedge family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus laevigatus subsp. albidus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Furthermore, its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties may help protect against oxidative stress and cellular damage, contributing to its potential health benefits.
